primitives.note: Contempt for the Weak adds bonus magic on-hit damage vs targets below 50% max HP, gated by a 10s per-target internal cooldown
P only triggers while target HP is below the 50% max-HP threshold
Q and E deal fixed base + bonus AD damage on cast/cooldown
The Shadow from W (and the longer-lived Shadow from R) mimics Zed's Q and E casts, adding extra damage instances against the same target
W and R each have a Shadow Swap recast; R additionally has a delayed detonation separate from the initial mark application
Energy costs (Q 75-55, W 40-20, E 40) meaningfully cap cast frequency in a 15s fight
Shadow Slash reduces Living Shadow's current cooldown by 3s per enemy champion hit
Marked for Death stores a % of all pre-mitigation physical/magic damage Zed and his Shadows deal to the target, detonating as physical damage at duration's end

needsBespoke.why: Zed's mechanics (on-hit conditional bonus, plain-cast abilities, a mimicking pet/summon, a stored-damage detonation on the target, and cooldown/energy interactions) are all expressible by combining existing primitives; no unique mechanic falls outside the closed list.

unsettled.question: Do Zed's Shadows (from W and R) automatically mimic every Q and E cast while active, adding a second (and while both a W-Shadow and R-Shadow exist, a third) full damage instance against the dummy, or does mimicry require some other condition not stated in the sources?
options: Every Q/E cast while a Shadow is active is automatically also cast by the Shadow, dealing a second full instance of that ability's damage to the target
Mimicry only happens under some additional unstated condition (e.g. only on the first cast after the Shadow spawns), so not every Q/E cast is doubled
quotes: '''Zed''' creates a ... ''Shadow'' that dashes to the target location and remains there for {{fd|5.25}} seconds, being able to mimic ''{{ai|Razor Shuriken|Zed}}'' and ''{{ai|Shadow Slash|Zed}}'' regardless of range.

unsettled.question: How long does the Shadow spawned by Death Mark actually persist and remain able to mimic Q/E: the wiki description states 9 seconds, but the bin's RShadowDurationDisplayed (7.5) and the calculated {43a019eb} (7.5+0.5=8) do not match 9?
quotes: '''Zed''' also spawns a [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' at his casting position for 9 seconds

proposal: Open by casting W (Living Shadow) onto or near the target so a Shadow is present to mimic upcoming Q/E casts.
Cast R (Death Mark) on the target to apply Marked for Death and spawn R's longer-lived Shadow, beginning the stored-damage window.
Immediately cast Q (Razor Shuriken) so both Zed and the active Shadow(s) hit the target with Q's damage.
Cast E (Shadow Slash) so Zed's and the Shadow's slashes both land on the target (extra slashes beyond the first apply no bonus damage but reduce W's cooldown).
Weave basic attacks between ability casts; Contempt for the Weak (P) adds bonus magic damage once the target drops below 50% max HP, subject to its 10s per-target cooldown.
Recast Q and E on cooldown as energy allows, prioritizing keeping a Shadow alive/present so it continues mimicking casts.
Let Marked for Death detonate at the end of its 3-second duration for its stored-damage physical burst.
Continue the Q/E/auto-attack loop for the remainder of the 15s window, recasting W to refresh a Shadow when its duration or R's Shadow lapses.
questions: Is Shadow mimicry of Q/E fully automatic on every cast while a Shadow is present, and does it happen for both a W-Shadow and an R-Shadow simultaneously if both exist?
What target health trajectory should the simulator assume for the dummy, since Contempt for the Weak's trigger and its 10s internal cooldown depend on when the target crosses the 50% HP threshold?

Given Q/W/E energy costs and Zed's max energy/regen (not given in these sources), is the proposed cast-everything-on-cooldown rotation energy-sustainable for the full 15s, or does energy force skipping some E or W casts?

Does the Death Mark detonation's stored-damage percentage draw only from damage dealt during the 3s Marked-for-Death window, or does it also include the R cast's own flat 100% AD component as a separate simultaneous hit rather than part of one combined detonation?
